original_interpretation: In August 2026, 107 TPEx-listed semiconductor companies reported combined monthly revenue of NT$102.2 bn, up 98.84% YoY.
notes: Unit is NT$ thousand, so 102.21 bn is correct. The table covers domestic and foreign companies ("檔案內容包含國內及國外公司") and uses consolidated revenue where there are subsidiaries. Unaudited company self-reports; claim_type fact is acceptable for an official compilation.

original_interpretation: e-MOPS (English) has profiles, financial statements and operating statements, filterable by market and industry sector, plus a 'Monthly Operating Revenue of Foreign Companies' report.
evidence_found: e-MOPS page text: "Profiles ... Summaries ... Financial Statements ... Operating Statements"; "Market : Select Market Listed Company TPEx Listed Company Emerging Stocks Public Company Industry sector"; row "ABLEPRINT TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD. 7734 APT TPEx Listed Company Semiconductor"; menu HTML: title="Monthly Operating Revenue of Foreign Companies" (under Foreign Listed Companies > Summary of All Foreign Companies).

original_interpretation: MOPS was set up on 1 Aug 2002 under FSC SFB guidance with TWSE and TPEx; its current version launched July 2010.
evidence_found: TEJ blog: "the 'original version' of the Market Observation Post System was established on August 1, 2002. The Market Observation Post System's current version is the 'new version,' launched in July 2010." TWSE article (2024-11-28): "於民國91年8月1日建立之網站" ... "歷經99年改版上線以來" ... "優化公開資訊觀測站於113年10月21日正式對外服務".
correction: The 2002 founding and the SFB/TWSE/TPEx roles are confirmed by TWSE itself. But the 2010 version is no longer current: an optimized MOPS officially went into service on 21 October 2024. TWSE gives the revamp year as 2010 (ROC 99) without the month. See the superseding claim.
notes: The original claim rests on a tier-3 vendor blog. The superseding claim cites TWSE (tier 1).

original_interpretation: Gudeng was in 'Other Electronic' until TPEx moved it to 'Semiconductor' on 1 June 2026, showing the category does not cover the whole chip supply chain.
evidence_found: Original CNA (2026-05-19): "川寶、泰茂、全域、弘塑、斐成、台聯電訊、欣厚、光譜電工、廣運、華電聯網、中湛、友鋮、智通科創等13家上櫃公司" ... "全域與弘塑由其他電子業分別調整為居家生活、半導體業". 家登 (Gudeng) is not in the list. The Washin rewrite reads "Chuan-yu and Gudeng from 'Other Electronic' to 'Home and Living' and 'Semiconductor'".
correction: The company moved from Other Electronic to Semiconductor on 1 June 2026 was Grand Process Technology (弘塑, 3131), not Gudeng (家登, 3680). The tier-3 English rewrite mistranslated the name. The general point stands, with Grand Process as the example. See the superseding claim.
notes: The researcher's ISIN cross-check (Gudeng in the Semiconductor list) does not show a June 2026 move. Gudeng is simply in that category; the MOPS Aug 2026 table lists both 3680 家登 and 3131 弘塑 under 半導體業.

original_interpretation: OpenDART lets users download original DART disclosures in XML and quarterly financial statements of KOSPI/KOSDAQ and major unlisted companies.
evidence_found: "You can download the original disclosure reports disclosed on DART in XML format to freely extract and use the desired information." ... "You can download the financial statements of the periodic reports submitted by listed corporations (KOSPI, KOSDAQ) and major unlisted corporations (subject to submit annual reports and IFRS applications) every quarter." (OpenDART Introduction)
notes: The browser rendered blank pages; the page HTML was fetched directly and parsed for the text.

original_interpretation: OpenDART calls need a 40-character key; 'call limit exceeded' usually comes after about 20,000 requests.
evidence_found: List API: "crtfc_key API authentication key STRING(40) Y Issued authentication key (40 digits)"; both API guides: "020 : Call limit exceeded. Although this error message is usually generated in response to at least 20,000 requests, it may occur at different thresholds if the rate limit is configured otherwise."
notes: The page says 'at least 20,000', which matches 'about 20,000' with the stated caveat. The page doesn't give the period (it is generally understood to be daily, but not confirmed here).

original_interpretation: The OpenDART company API returns induty_code and corp_cls (Y KOSPI, K KOSDAQ, N KONEX, E other).
evidence_found: Company API response fields: "corp_cls Corporation type Corporation type: Y (KOSPI), K (KOSDAQ), N (KONEX), E (Other)" ... "induty_code Industry code Industry code".
notes: The page doesn't say which classification standard induty_code uses. Enumerating filers by industry also needs the corp_code list (a separate API); this is a reasonable reading, not stated on the page.

original_interpretation: DART carries KOSPI, KOSDAQ, KONEX and 'others' disclosures; on 30 Sep 2026 it showed 219 disclosures, 127 from 'others'.
evidence_found: English DART on 2026-10-01: tabs "KOSPI Market KOSDAQ Market KONEX Market OTHERS ALL 5%ㆍExecutive FUND"; live counter "[ 2026-10-01 10:28 ] ... ALL(146) ... KOSPI(41) KOSDAQ(50) KONEX(0) OTHERS(55) 5%ㆍExecutive(21) FUND(42)".
correction: The market categories are confirmed. The 219/127 counts are a live 'Today's Disclosure' counter that resets daily and can't be reproduced; on 1 Oct 2026 it read ALL 146, OTHERS 55. Treat the counts as a one-day snapshot, not a structural figure.
notes: The page disclaimer also says English disclosures are voluntary and have no legal effect.

original_interpretation: EDINET API v2 offers a document-list API and a document-retrieval API, and needs an API key obtained by creating an account.
evidence_found: "EDINET は、次の２つのAPI を提供します。" ... "EDINET に提出された書類の一覧を取得するAPI（以下「書類一覧API」という。）" ... "EDINET に提出された書類を取得するAPI（以下「書類取得API」という。）"; "EDINET API への接続の際には、EDINET から発行されたキー（以下「API キー」という。）を使用した認証を行います。API キーの取得に際しては、アカウントの作成が必要" (§1-2-1, §2-3; spec dated 2026年４月)

original_interpretation: EDINET keeps annual and half-year reports viewable for 10 years (5+5) and quarterly reports for 10 years (3+7).
evidence_found: §1-2-2 table: "有価証券報告書 5 年 5 年 10 年 半期報告書 5 年 5 年 10 年 四半期報告書 3 年 7 年 10 年"; note: "半期報告書については、2024 年(令和6 年)4 月1 日以後提出の書類が延長期間の対象。四半期報告書については、2015 年(平成27 年)4 月1 日以後提出の書類が延長期間の対象。"
notes: Caveat: the 5-year extension for half-year reports applies only to filings from 1 Apr 2024, and the 7-year extension for quarterly reports only to filings from 1 Apr 2015. Older filings get only the statutory period.

original_interpretation: EDINET flags English files (englishDocFlag), meaning most filings are Japanese-only.
evidence_found: Response field: "英文ファイル有無フラグ englishDocFlag string 半角 書類に英文ファイルがある場合は \"1\"、それ以外は\"0\"が出力されます。"
correction: The englishDocFlag field is confirmed. 'Most filings are Japanese-only' does not follow from the existence of a flag; the source gives no share of English filings.
notes: Mixed fact and inference; the second half should be a separate inference claim or an unknown.

original_interpretation: EDINET is the FIEA electronic disclosure system for annual securities reports, registration statements and large-shareholding reports, running 24 hours a day.
evidence_found: "EDINETは、「金融商品取引法に基づく有価証券報告書等の開示書類に関する電子開示システム」のことで、有価証券報告書、有価証券届出書、大量保有報告書等の開示書類について ... 24時間365日（定期保守等の計画停止期間は除く。）、稼働しています。" (FSA, updated 令和７年５月14日)
notes: 24/365 excludes planned maintenance outages.

original_interpretation: Japan abolished quarterly securities reports from 1 Apr 2024; listed companies file half-year reports instead, due within 45 days (60 for certain companies).
evidence_found: "改正法により、四半期報告書等に関する規定 ... が削除され、上場会社等は四半期報告書に代えて半期報告書の提出が必要となる" ... "新法第24条の５第１項の表の第１号の下欄に規定する政令で定める期間を45日とし、同表の第２号の下欄に規定する政令で定める期間を60日とする" ... "施行日（令和６年４月１日）" (FSA 政令（案）の概要, 2023-12-08)
correction: Substance confirmed, but the source is the summary of the draft (案) cabinet order, not the promulgated order. The 45/60-day periods apply to the two categories in the table of new FIEA Art. 24-5(1). The source does not name which companies get 60 days.
notes: The abolition comes from the enacted 2023 amendment act (Law No. 79 of 2023), so that part is firm. Only the day counts rest on draft text.

original_interpretation: SICC assigns a sector from the sub-classification with the largest sales, using the annual securities report.
evidence_found: Art. 4: "the main business ... shall be the sub classification item that has the largest total amount of sales of the businesses of Target Entity, etc. under the main classification item that has the largest total amount of sales of said businesses." Art. 5: "The material used to determine the sector shall be the annual securities report or equivalent financial statements."
notes: Initial classification (Art. 6) also uses 3 past years plus 2 years of the company's profit plan. Last amended 3 Apr 2006 per the document.

original_interpretation: Kioxia listed on TSE on 18 Dec 2024 as the first IPO using the S-1 (pre-approval registration) method, filed 8 Nov 2024.
evidence_found: "2024 年12 月18 日、キオクシアホールディングス株式会社 ... が、東京証券取引所への上場を果たした。本案件は ... 2023 年10 月に導入された上場承認前の有価証券届出書の提出（いわゆる「S-1 方式」）が利用された初のIPO として注目を集めた。"; table "承認前届出書（2024 年11 月8 日（金））" (AMT newsletter Dec 2024)
notes: Law-firm newsletter from the underwriters' counsel (tier 3 'other'); reported_claim is the right type. The 'first IPO' framing is the firm's.

original_interpretation: CSRC requires annual reports within 4 months, interim within 2 months, and quarterly reports within 1 month after months 3 and 9.
evidence_found: 2007 text Art. 20: "Annual report shall be prepared and disclosed within 4 months ... Interim report ... within 2 months ... quarterly report ... within 1 month since the end of the 3rd and 9th month". Current Order 226 (effective 2025-07-01): "第十二条 上市公司应当披露的定期报告包括年度报告、中期报告。" "第十三条 年度报告应当在每个会计年度结束之日起四个月内，中期报告 ... 两个月内".
correction: The 2007 Regulations were replaced (Order 182 in 2021, then Order 226 from 1 Jul 2025). The current Measures list only annual (4 months) and interim (2 months) reports; the quarterly report and its 1-month deadline are no longer in them. See the superseding claim.
notes: Quarterly reporting may still be required by SSE/SZSE listing rules; not checked.

original_interpretation: CSRC requires A-share disclosure in Chinese (Chinese prevails), published via CSRC-appointed media before the company's own website.
evidence_found: 2007 Art. 8: "Information disclosure shall be made in Chinese ... the Chinese version will prevail." Art. 6: "shall not make the disclosure on their own websites or other media before it's published on the appointed media." Order 226 (2025): "第十条 信息披露文件应当采用中文文本 ... 以中文文本为准"; "第八条 依法披露的信息，应当在证券交易所的网站和符合中国证监会规定条件的媒体发布". No 'not before appointed media' clause found in the 2025 text.
correction: The Chinese-language and Chinese-prevails rule is still current (Art. 10, Order 226). The publication rule has changed: disclosures now go on the exchange website and media meeting CSRC conditions, and the 2007 ban on publishing on own websites before the appointed media is not in the 2025 text. See the superseding claim.

original_interpretation: China's listed-company industry classification follows CAPCO's guideline (effective 1 May 2023, based on GB/T 4754-2017): the ≥50%-revenue rule, reviewed every six months.
evidence_found: "第四条 本《指引》参照《国民经济行业分类》（GB T4754-2017）"; "第九条 当上市公司某类业务的营业收入比重大于或等于50%，原则上将其划入该业务相对应的行业。"; "第十五条 上市公司行业分类按半年度进行。每年6月10日和12月20日为定期行业分类工作的起始日。"; "第十九条 ... 于2023年5月1日施行。"
notes: Exceptions exist: a company with ≥50% revenue from one business can apply to be classed in another business with ≥30% revenue and ≥50% gross profit (Art. 9(2)). Art. 10 uses 30% revenue/gross-profit rules when no business reaches 50%.

original_interpretation: SSE's industry list uses the CAPCO classification standard and results.
evidence_found: "中国上市公司协会行业分类 数据日期：2026-09-30" ... "行业分类标准：中国上市公司协会发布的《中国上市公司协会上市公司行业统计分类指引》 行业分类结果：中国上市公司协会分类结果"

original_interpretation: CSRC approved CNINFO as one of five designated disclosure websites (for ChiNext).
evidence_found: "日期：2009-09-22 来源：上海证监局" ... "中国证监会已批复“巨潮资讯网”（网址：www.cninfo.com.cn）、“中国证券网” ... 等 5 家网站为创业板信息披露指定网站。（信息来源： 9 月 21 日《上海证券报》）"
notes: The page is dated 2009-09-22 (the researcher recorded it as undated) and reposts a Shanghai Securities News item; the source date has been updated. This is historical (2009). Under Order 226 the 'appointed media' concept has been replaced by 'media meeting CSRC conditions', so the designation's current legal weight is unclear.

original_interpretation: As of June 2025, STAR had 119 IC companies of 588 listed, which the exchange calls half of similar A-share companies, across design, foundry and packaging/test.
evidence_found: "As of June 12, 2025, the number of SSE STAR Market-listed companies reached 588" ... "the total number of companies in the integrated circuit sector has reached 119, accounting for half of similar A-share listed companies, covering upstream chip design, midstream wafer foundry, and downstream packaging and testing" (SRC-0785); SRC-0786: "the sector's 119 companies span the entire industrial chain ... accounting for half of similar A-share companies".
notes: Both are translated press articles (Securities Times / Shanghai Securities News) on the SSE English site, so source_type news is honest. A later count is 128 IC firms in the FY2025 forecast season, March 2026 (CLM-2212).

original_interpretation: A 2026 report counted 128 STAR IC firms with FY2025 forecast revenue of RMB 365.1 bn, 76 of them chip design (incl. IDM).
evidence_found: "the 128 integrated circuit firms on the Star Market are projected to achieve total revenue of 365.112 billion yuan, a 25% year-on-year increase" ... "the 76 chip design (including IDM) companies on the Star Market are expected to achieve combined revenue of 163.103 billion yuan" (Tiger Brokers / Deep News, dated "03/12")
notes: Tier-3 syndicated article, dated 03/12 with no year shown; the content (2026 Government Work Report, first two months of 2026) puts it at 12 Mar 2026. Figures are aggregated company forecasts, not audited results, and the article does not name the source of the statistics.

original_interpretation: CXMT's STAR prospectus was released on SSE on 9 Jul 2026; CSRC published a first progress report on YMTC's IPO guidance on 19 May 2026.
evidence_found: "according to the company's prospectus released on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on July 9" ... "The China Securities Regulatory Commission published the first progress report on Yangtze Memory Technologies Co's IPO guidance process on May 19, stating that CITIC Securities and China Securities Co would serve as the IPO advisors." (Global Times, published Jul 15, 2026)
notes: News source (tier 3); the year 2026 follows from the publication date. The source date has been updated to 2026-07-15.

original_interpretation: HKEX Main Board issuers must send annual reports within 4 months of FY-end, in English with a Chinese translation.
evidence_found: Rule 13.46(1)(a): "... not more than four months after the end of the financial year to which they relate." Note 1: "The directors' report, auditors' report, annual accounts ... must be in the English language and must be accompanied by a Chinese translation." Rule 13.46(2) Note 1 (overseas issuers): "If the issuer's primary listing is or is to be on another stock exchange such documents must be in the English language or be accompanied by a certified English translation."
correction: The 4-month deadline applies to all Main Board issuers. The English-plus-Chinese-translation requirement applies to Hong Kong-incorporated issuers (13.46(1)) and to overseas issuers with a primary listing in Hong Kong. Overseas issuers with a primary listing elsewhere need only English, or a certified English translation.

original_interpretation: Hong Kong DI notices under SFO Part XV must be filed electronically via DION since 3 July 2017 and are published on HKEXnews.
evidence_found: "Note: From 3 July 2017, all notices are required to be filed electronically through DION System. Such requirement was subject to a transitional arrangement whereby filer could submit notices through DION System or other filing means between 3 July and 2 October 2017." ... "HKEX operates electronic filing systems for the submission of completed DI forms and publishes the disclosure information filed with it on the HKEX website in accordance with the requirement of the SFC."
notes: Mandatory e-filing only fully took effect after the transition ended on 2 Oct 2017.

original_interpretation: HKEXnews publishes Main Board prospectuses; 2026 chip listings included Montage (6809) and Axera (600); a 'P' suffix marks Chapter 18C pre-commercial companies.
evidence_found: web_extract copy: "| 6809 | Montage Technology Co., Ltd. | Download | | 600 | Axera Semiconductor Co., Ltd. | Download | Download |"; both versions: "A Pre-Commercial Company listed under Chapter 18C of the Listing Rules has its name that ends with marker \"P\"."
notes: The page is a rolling list. The live page on 2026-10-01 (updated 30 Sep 2026) no longer shows Montage or Axera, but shows other chip names such as Beijing ESWIN Computing Technology (1256). Axera's own site gives its listing date as 10 Feb 2026 (not added as a source).

original_interpretation: HSICS has sector 7030 Semiconductors with subsectors 703010 and 703020, assigned mainly by sales revenue from the latest audited annual report.
evidence_found: "7030 Semiconductors 703010 Semiconductors Designers, manufacturers and distributors of semiconductors such as microprocessors and memory chips 703020 Semiconductor Equipment & Materials"; "The primary parameter of industry classification is the sales revenue from each business area of a listed company."; "based on audited financial information of the latest financial year contained in the company's annual report."
notes: Profit or assets may also be considered (brochure). Hang Seng Indexes is an index provider; research_firm is an acceptable source_type.

original_interpretation: HSICS covers 12 industries, 31 sectors, 114 subsectors and excludes Chapter 18B (SPAC) companies.
evidence_found: "Covering 12 industries, 31 sectors and 114 subsectors, the three-tier HSICS ..."; "HSICS will not cover companies listed under Chapter 18B of HKEX listing rules."

original_interpretation: GICS: Industry Group 4530 / Industry 453010 Semiconductors & Semiconductor Equipment; sub-industries 45301010 Semiconductor Materials & Equipment and 45301020 Semiconductors.
evidence_found: GICS Methodology April 2026, p.11 structure: "4530 Semiconductors & Semiconductor Equipment 453010 Semiconductors & Semiconductor Equipment 45301010 Semiconductor Materials & Equipment 45301020 Semiconductors".
notes: The PDF was downloaded via the browser; web_extract returned only a partial summary.

original_interpretation: GICS initially classifies by the >60% revenue sub-industry, else the largest share (at least 50%) of both revenues and earnings.
evidence_found: p.15 §3.1: "A company is initially classified into the GICS Sub-Industry whose definition most accurately reflects the business activity that generates more than 60% of the company's total revenues. If a company is engaged in two or more distinct business activities and no single activity contributes 60% or more of total revenues, the company is initially classified in the Sub-Industry that accounts for the largest share (at least 50%) of both revenues and earnings."
notes: There are further fallbacks (largest combined contribution to revenues and earnings, then further analysis).

original_interpretation: 45301010 was renamed from 'Semiconductor Equipment' to 'Semiconductor Materials & Equipment' effective March 2023.
evidence_found: Summary table p.12: "New Name 45301010 Semiconductor Equipment Semiconductor Materials & Equipment" (Revisions to the GICS Structure Effective March 2023, 31 Mar 2022).

original_interpretation: GICS is proprietary; MSCI/S&P DJI forbid using the information to create databases or indices without permission, so a GICS-based company list can't be republished freely.
evidence_found: SRC-0794 disclaimer p.15: "The Information may not be reproduced or redisseminated in whole or in part without prior written permission from MSCI and S&P Dow Jones Indices. The Information may not be used to create derivative works ... the Information may not be used to create indices, databases, risk models, analytics, software". SRC-0793 (Apr 2026): "(ix) to populate a database"; "GICS ... is the exclusive property of MSCI and S&P Dow Jones Indices."
correction: Proprietary status and the use restrictions are confirmed. But the disclaimer governs the 'Information' in these documents, which is the structure and definitions. Company-level GICS assignments are separately licensed data not covered by these documents. 'Cannot be republished freely' is our reading of the licence, not a statement in the source.
notes: Fact plus interpretation; the last clause is better recorded as an interpretation claim.

original_interpretation: The NSE Indices July 2023 classification has no semiconductor basic industry; 'semiconductor' doesn't appear; computer hardware is under 'IT - Hardware'.
evidence_found: Downloaded the PDF (23 pp.) and searched the full text: no match for 'semicon'. p.18: "IN080103 IT - Hardware IN080103001 Computers Hardware & Equipments Manufactures and distributors of computer hardware and equipments such as personal computers, laptops, servers, motherboards, networking equipments, printers, photo copiers etc." 197 distinct basic-industry codes in the document.
notes: Currency check: the NSE industry-classification page (updated 21/09/2023) still describes '12 Macro-Economic Sectors, 22 Sectors, 59 Industries and 197 Basic Industries', the same as the July 2023 structure. No newer structure was found.

original_interpretation: MAYA (launched 2000) carries TASE corporate filings; English version launched 2020; English filing voluntary except dual-listed companies, which file all disclosures in English.
evidence_found: "The MAYA website ... was initially launched in 2000 and is the site on which corporate filings ... are posted." "TASE announces today the launch of the English version of its 'MAYA' corporate website." (June 29, 2020) "Listed companies can voluntarily file in English." "Some 54 companies ... are currently dually listed on TASE ... and file all disclosures in English."
notes: As of June 2020 (54 dual-listed companies then). The release describes dual-listed companies' practice; it does not cite a legal requirement.

original_interpretation: Companies with securities on an EU regulated market in the Netherlands must file annual and semi-annual reports with the AFM on publication; these enter the AFM Register of Financial Reporting.
evidence_found: web_extract copy: "When listed companies publish their annual and semi-annual financial reports, these reports must be simultaneously filed with the AFM via the AFM Portal. The filed information will be included in the Register of Financial Reporting." Live browser copy of the same URL (2026-10-01): "Issuers whose home Member State is the Netherlands shall file their reports with the AFM." "... no later than four months after the end of the financial year." "Semi-annual reports shall be published and filed with the AFM within three months after the end of the first half".
correction: The filing duty applies to issuers whose home Member State is the Netherlands, not to every company listed on a Dutch regulated market. Deadlines: annual report within 4 months, semi-annual within 3 months. The current live page no longer mentions the Register of Financial Reporting in its body text; an earlier copy did.

original_interpretation: SEMI publishes a free, searchable online member directory with company descriptions across chemicals, equipment, engineering and components.
evidence_found: web_extract: "All Results" cards incl. "Texchem Polymer Engineering Sdn. Bhd. ... design, development, and manufacture of automated assisted transport equipment for advanced wafers"; "RayZher Technology Co.,Ltd. ... Fab Mechanical and Electrical and Basic Engineering ... Gas& chemical supply System"; "AS Strömungstechnik ... safe dispensing and filling systems"; "Lian Ee Hydraulics ... hoses and instrumentation piping".
correction: Public access without login, and descriptions spanning equipment, engineering, chemical handling and components, are confirmed. A search function was not confirmed (the browser hit a Cloudflare check; the extract shows only result cards).
notes: The directory lists members only, so it is a discovery aid, not a full census of suppliers.
